one_liner: Jira Cloud has a broad, free, self-serve REST v3 API with OAuth 2.0 (3LO) and API tokens, plus an official Atlassian Rovo MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) for multi-user apps; API tokens are used via Basic auth (email:token); Connect uses JWT you mint yourself. Points-based rate limits apply to OAuth apps since March 2026.
access_notes: REST API is free on all Jira plans including Free; user API tokens need no approval. Per-tenant rate-limit quota increases require Atlassian review.
blocker_notes: Only minor friction: points-based rate limits for OAuth apps.

evidence.quote: Choice of user API tokens, OAuth 2.0 (3LO) with scopes, Connect JWT, or Forge scoped permissions.
Jira account email (used for Basic auth)

Self-serve on every tier including Free: user API tokens need no approval; Forge and Connect open the app platform.
Issues, projects, boards, sprints, workflows, users, permissions, and audit records, with bulk issue endpoints.
